settings.tab_content: Roasted in 12kg micro batches using traditional cast-iron drum roasters. Roast profiles are monitored via advanced thermal probes.
Sourced directly from organic smallholder cooperatives in Sidamo, Ethiopia and Huila, Colombia. Farmers are paid 45% above Fair Trade minimums.
Whole bean recommended. For drip, grind medium-coarse (resembling sea salt). For espresso, grind fine (resembling table salt).
Packed in high-barrier bags fitted with one-way degassing valves and immediately flushed with nitrogen to prevent staling.
